text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, Jordan.
Free this Saturday? Wanna hit up a cafe?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, it's a date. I wanna try that limited-time latte.
—Mm, see ya. Good night.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oh, heading out this weekend?
You should definitely kick back and relax to your heart's content!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's the plan—
...Hm?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh, are you kidding me? A sudden reshoot?
And on Saturday, of all days...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ah~ damn it, worst timing ever...
I gotta let Jordan know...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for the wait. Also, my bad about Saturday.
They made design changes to the items, so we have to do a reshoot.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Well~ it's work, so can't be helped.
Don't sweat it~

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'm still gonna go drink it, though. That concentrated carrot latte!
I'll spam ya with reviews while you're working, City!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Heh. That's harsh.
—Ah, hold on, call from my manager.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Jordan, Saturday's reshoot got scrapped.
Sounds like the design might get flipped around again after all.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
So yeah, I'm heading to the cafe with you.
I'm having that concentrated carrot latte too.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
For real?! We can go together after all?!
Then we gotta post our review on Umastagram together!

text_block_list.name: Two Horse Girls
text_block_list.text: So good...!

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Honestly I'm almost mad. What even is this?!
The carrot flavor is totally exploding!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ah, crap. It's already empty... went down in seconds.
Should've ordered the XXL size.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, should we go for seconds?
We totally should, right? Let's do it~!

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Or wait, how about we get takeout and hit up karaoke?
I wanna party like crazy surrounded by the smell of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I'm down. I'm definitely not in the mood to just head straight home after this anyway.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Welcome back!
Working late must be tough!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Nah, I was hanging out with Jordan.
In the end, it got rescheduled again.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ehh?! Again?!
Your schedule really changes on a dime, huh...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
It's tough on you, City, but it must be rough on Jordan too.
It's always best to be able to make plans with peace of mind, after all.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Jordan...? She's...
She's fine with it, though...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Is that so?
Well, as long as it's fine, then...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Yeah... I mean, it's always kind of like this with us...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day. I spotted Gold City lost in thought by herself in the cafeteria.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
............
Wait. Is it really okay, though...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seemed like something was weighing on her mind...
